lines.zh: 翅膀一拍一拍，我飘过草尖。
lines.en: Wingbeat by wingbeat, I drift over the grass tips.

lines.zh: 黄翅膀在阳光下，薄得透光。
lines.en: My yellow wings are thin enough to let the sun through.
I rise and dip. Never a straight line.
Blue flowers over there. I've spotted them.
A gust comes and carries me along.

lines.zh: 我绕着同一朵花转了半圈。
lines.en: I circle the same flower half a turn.

lines.zh: 翅膀上的纹路，是深色的边。
lines.en: My wings have a dark border.

lines.zh: 我从叶子上方低低掠过。
lines.en: I skim low over the leaves.
Where the sun is, that's where I go.
I settle on a blade of grass to rest.

lines.zh: 花粉粘在我腿上，黄黄的。
lines.en: Pollen clings yellow to my legs.

lines.zh: 这么轻的身体，风都推得动。
lines.en: A body this light gets pushed by any breeze.

lines.zh: 我从这丛飞到那丛，不远。
lines.en: Clump to clump. Not far.

lines.zh: 翅膀扇得很快，听不见声音。
lines.en: My wings beat fast, without a sound.

lines.zh: 我贴着一人多高的地方飞。
lines.en: I fly about a person's height up.
I steer around the web. Carefully.

lines.zh: 我停在花瓣上，收着翅膀。
lines.en: I rest on a petal, wings closed.
The petal is soft. It sways when I move.

lines.zh: 太阳一到，我就从叶背出来。
lines.en: Once the sun is up I leave the underside of the leaf.

lines.zh: 我慢慢张开翅膀，晒一晒。
lines.en: I open my wings slowly to sun them.
This meadow has plenty of flowers.
I sip once. Sweet.

lines.zh: 有只蜜蜂在旁边，各做各的。
lines.en: A bee nearby. We mind our own business.
My antennae flex.

lines.zh: 活着的时间不长，所以不快也不慢。
lines.en: I haven't long to live, so I take it steady.

lines.zh: 我把翅膀合起来，像一片叶。
lines.en: I close my wings and look like a leaf.

lines.zh: 我在一片草叶上收拢翅膀。
lines.en: I fold my wings on a blade of grass.
I count the flowers opening today.

lines.zh: 你这么大，我只有指甲盖那么点。
lines.en: You're huge. I'm the size of a fingernail.

lines.zh: 你站在花中间，我不敢过去。
lines.en: You're standing among the flowers. I daren't cross.
When you move, the air changes.

lines.zh: 我停在你帽檐边上歇一歇。
lines.en: I rest a moment on the brim of your hat.

lines.zh: 你站着不动，我先看看再说。
lines.en: You stand still, so I look you over first.
I land on your sleeve. Don't swat.

lines.zh: 你抬头，我就在你眼睛前面。
lines.en: You look up, and I'm right before your eyes.

lines.zh: 你的手指伸过来，我往上躲。
lines.en: Your finger reaches for me and I dodge upward.
Your shadow covers the flowers.

lines.zh: 我退了半步，其实是一振翅。
lines.en: I back off half a step — really one wingbeat.

lines.zh: 翅膀被按了一下，飞得歪了。
lines.en: A wing got pressed and now I fly crooked.
I fall onto the grass and crawl twice.
I'm so small. One hit is fatal.

lines.zh: 我的腿黏在露水上，挣不开。
lines.en: My legs are stuck in the dew and I cannot pull free.

lines.zh: 我扇了几下，也没升起来。
lines.en: I beat my wings. No lift.
Scale dust falls everywhere.
I creep along the ground.
It hurts more than I can bear.
I can still fly. Just a little.
One more gust and I'm gone.
Blue flowers. Exactly what I want.

lines.zh: 我落下去，把口器伸进去。
lines.en: I settle and dip my proboscis in.
This one's opened just right.
Sweet. Sweeter than the last.
I move to another and sip again.
I know this flower. Good nectar.
You're holding it out. I daren't land.
Set it down. I'll come to it.

lines.zh: 我扇一下翅膀就授一次粉。
lines.en: Every wingbeat pollinates a flower.
One more sip and I'm off.
One touch and I tumbled.
My wings picked up dust.

lines.zh: 你走路的震动，整片草都在抖。
lines.en: Your footsteps shake the whole meadow.
I skim past your finger.
I clipped a blade of grass and veered.

lines.zh: 这么轻的一撞，我差点掉。
lines.en: A bump that light nearly dropped me.
Step back. I'm going for that flower.

lines.zh: 我落在你手背上，很快又飞走。
lines.en: I land on your hand and leave at once.
Don't blow at me. I can't take it.
We bumped and both wobbled.

lines.zh: 绕着同一朵花，就是我们的事。
lines.en: Circling the same flower — that's our way.

lines.zh: 我们飞得很近，翅膀差点碰到。
lines.en: We fly close. Our wings nearly touch.
Are you after pollen too?
Follow me, to that clump of blue.

lines.zh: 我们一起落在同一片叶上。
lines.en: We settle on the same leaf.
Days like this don't last.
You circle me once. I understand.

lines.zh: 卵会落在叶子上，那是以后的事。
lines.en: Eggs will go on a leaf. That's later.
For now, just fly a while.
Don't go too far. The wind takes you.
I can't tell what this is.
I land on it. Too smooth.
I couldn't lift even this.

lines.zh: 花粉倒是一点，粘在腿上。
lines.en: A bit of pollen, though. On my legs.
I tap it with a foreleg.
The little yellow flower in the grass is me.
I circle it. Can't move it.
It glints in the sun.
I perch on it to rest.

lines.zh: 这么大的东西，不归我管。
lines.en: Something this big isn't my business.
A flower over there. I see it.
I correct my heading and go.
Something behind the leaf?
I hover, wings working.
Away. I'll be there soon.

lines.zh: 我锁定那一点黄色以外的东西。
lines.en: I fix on something that isn't yellow.

lines.zh: 花枝晃了一下，我赶紧起飞。
lines.en: The flower stem moved; I take off at once.
I'll rise a little first.
At this distance I'm there in a moment.
I watch it, wings never still.
I keep circling it.

lines.zh: 我贴着花瓣绕，它转不过身。
lines.en: I hug the petals and it cannot turn after me.
I'm waiting for it to settle.
The wind pushes it away. I follow.
It's small. I can keep track.

lines.zh: 我停在半空，翅膀扇得很快。
lines.en: I hover, wings beating fast.
It seems to see me too.
I won't come closer. I'll watch first.
A flower hides half of it.
Wait a while for the wind.
One flap of yellow, and the grass bends.

lines.zh: 这么轻的一下，也够你烦。
lines.en: That light a blow still annoys you.

lines.zh: 我撞过去，然后立刻飞开。
lines.en: I bump it and dart away.

lines.zh: 我落在它鼻子上，很快又走。
lines.en: I land on its nose and leave at once.

lines.zh: 其实我没力气，可我会挡。
lines.en: I've no strength, but I can get in the way.
My legs are thin. They don't hurt.

lines.zh: 我围着头转，让它看不清。
lines.en: I circle its head so it can't see.
One pass is all. More wears me out.
Pollen comes off my wings.
I'm gone. You can't follow.

lines.zh: 我从一片叶子上张开了翅膀。
lines.en: I open my wings on a leaf.
It's bright out. I keep still at first.
I fan my wings a few times.
The air is warm.
I lift off, almost silent.
This meadow is full of flowers.
I settle on the nearest blue flower.
A day begins in the morning.

lines.zh: 我从蛹里出来，翅膀还软。
lines.en: I just left the chrysalis; my wings are still soft.
I fly where the light is.

lines.zh: 火一近，我的翅膀就卷了。
lines.en: Fire neared and my wings curled.
I fell and landed on the grass.
Water sticks my wings together.
The blast threw me a long way.

lines.zh: 有东西扎穿了我的翅膀。
lines.en: Something punched through my wing.

lines.zh: 那光一闪，我什么都看不见。
lines.en: A flash, and I could see nothing.

lines.zh: 找不到花，我飞得越来越低。
lines.en: No flowers. I fly lower and lower.
Thunder came and I curled up tight.

lines.zh: 四下什么都没有，我往下掉。
lines.en: Nothing around me at all, and I keep falling.
